subject: Encryption & KMS follow-up — PayWise security questions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@paywise.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: encryption / KMS items from today's call

Hi Alice — thanks for the time today, and for walking through PayWise's compliance requirements. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- In-transit: Redwood endpoints use TLS 1.2/1.3 with certs issued by public CAs. We support mTLS for private deployments.
- At-rest: Model weights and customer payloads are encrypted at rest using AES-256.
- Customer-managed keys: We support customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) as well as an HSM-backed option for Private deployments.
- BYOK / key rotation: Envelope encryption model — customer CMK is used to wrap per-tenant data keys; we support scheduled rotations and manual rotation APIs.
- Logging/audit: Request/response telemetry is logged for operational monitoring; PII can be redacted at ingestion, and audit logs are immutable and exportable to your SIEM. Retention is configurable (default 90 days for hosted).

Requested items we agreed to share:
1) SOC 2 Type II summary and scope (attached).
2) High-level architecture diagram for KMS flow (attached).
3) Short note on keys-in-use lifecycle and rotation APIs.

Could you confirm whether PayWise requires:
- Dedicated keys per environment (prod/staging) or per-customer CMKs?
- HSM-backed FIPS 140-2/3 requirement or soft KMS is acceptable?

Next step: Rishi (cc'd) will scope an options doc and Dev can give a quick walkthrough of the BYOK flow. Happy to hop on a short follow-up with your security team early next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: SOC2-type2-summary.pdf, redwood-arch-diagram.pdf

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@paywise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@paywise.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption / KMS items from today's call

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our InfoSec team:

- Prefer per-customer CMKs for production, but per-environment keys may be acceptable for early pilots.
- We require HSM-backed key storage for prod keys (FIPS 140-2 level 3 preferred).
- Retention: we need logs retained for 1 year with export to our Splunk instance; are audit logs immutable and can they be pushed to our collector?
- PII: we will need to confirm what fields you consider PII and whether Redwood can redact before storing logs. Can you provide an example of the redaction options?

Also: can you confirm if you support on-prem Private deployment (air-gapped) with customer-managed HSM? If not immediately available, please indicate timeline and the gating items.

We can do a security deep-dive on Wed 11/11 at 10am PT if that works for you.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Director, Information Security | PayWise
alice.chen@paywise.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@paywise.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption / KMS items from today's call

Hi Alice — great questions. Summary answers below and attached a one-page KMS key-flow graphic.

- Per-customer CMKs: Supported. For Hosted customers we offer a BYOK flow where PayWise CMKs in your cloud account are used to wrap tenant keys; for Dedicated/Private we can provision tenant-isolated keys or connect to your managed HSM.
- HSM-backed: We support HSM-backed keys via Cloud KMS providers (AWS CloudHSM, Google Cloud HSM) and can integrate with customer HSMs for Private deployments. We can provide FIPS compliance details; HSM-backed KMS is supported for production keys.
- Audit logs: Audit logs are immutable within Redwood and can be exported to your SIEM (S3 export, streaming to Kinesis/ PubSub, or native Splunk forwarder integration). Retention is configurable; hosted default is 90 days but we can accommodate 1 year for contractual customers (will reflect in the SOW).
- PII redaction: We support pluggable pre-processing hooks — you can supply a JSON schema of fields to redact. Options: full field removal, hashing, or tokenization before logs persist. We can share examples (attached) and a short config snippet for redaction rules.
- On-prem / air-gapped: We have a Private deployment offering that can be deployed on-prem behind your network with customer-managed HSM; timeline is project-dependent but we can support an initial engagement within 6–8 weeks for enterprise customers (subject to legal and infra readiness).

Attachments included: KMS-keyflow.png (key wrapping flow), SOC2-type2-summary.pdf (scope), redwood-arch-diagram.pdf.

We'll confirm the Wed 11/11 10am PT deep-dive — Rishi, can you join to cover contractual/operational items? Dev, can you be prepared to walkthrough the BYOK rotation API?

Thanks — talk soon.

Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@paywise.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption / KMS items from today's call

Alice — thanks for the quick replies and for scheduling the deep-dive. Logistics & next steps: 

1) Deep-dive confirmed: Wed 11/11 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).
2) RACI: PayWise Security leads the requirements; Redwood will provide technical docs, SOC2 evidence, and a PoC plan.
3) Contractual: We'll add the 1-year log retention and HSM-backed key requirement as configurable SOW items. I'll ask legal for a DOC change for enterprise terms and share a draft.
4) Action items before the call:
   - Marissa: prepare KMS flow + redaction examples (attached).
   - Dev: BYOK rotation API demo (5–10 min).
   - PayWise: confirm preferred CMK model (per-customer or per-environment) and provide the Splunk endpoint for log export.

DocuSign link for our standard enterprise addendum / security appendix: https://www.docusign.com/link/pw-nonprod-nda

If PayWise wants an on-prem proof-of-concept, we can scope resource needs after the call. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
